forward_process.v: VP: xt=alpha*x0+sigma*epsilon; 1000 linear betas1e-6..0.01; uniform discrete t; target alpha*epsilon-sigma*x0

sampler.v: Deterministic DDIM, exact NFE; x0=alpha*xt-sigma*v; x0 clamp[-1,1], consistent epsilon recomputation

loss: Valid LST mask per-record v-target MSE, equal average across records; no REPA or SNR weighting.
budget_basis: User authorized baseline training, selected v-prediction, and accepted corrected HLS preprocessing; retain batch128/two epochs/full validation.
initialization: Fresh TimeGeoDiT; frozen pretrained Prithvi; historical checkpoints are not compatible.
gpu_constraint: One A100-40GB, maximum one GPU job at a time, no H200.

conditioning.calendar: Target LST month, 3 periodic harmonics; not HLS acquisition month or sequence position.
conditioning.geolocation: Actual crop center WGS84 latitude/longitude -> unit sphere xyz -> xyz plus sin/cos at pi*[1,2,4].
conditioning.fusion: Separate 128-dimensional calendar/geography MLPs, concatenate with diffusion-time embedding, MLP to1024.
conditioning.injection: Every block self-attention/cross-attention/SwiGLU adaLN and final adaLN; zero-initialized gates/head retained.
conditioning.orthogonality: Disjoint concatenated input blocks; no post-fusion orthogonality constraint.
conditioning.hls: Existing Prithvi cross-attention only; direct HLS concat not added in this revision.

hls_input.valid: Unclipped reflectance -> official DN mean/std normalization
